name: VideoVault DaVinci Resolve Extension
releaseNotes:
- Open the panel from Workspace > Workflow Integrations > VideoVault and leave it open while you work.
- The panel shows whether the VideoVault Desktop App is running, which Resolve project is open, and whether your activity is being reported.
- If the Desktop App is closed, your activity is saved on your computer and sent when it opens again.
- Renders started from Resolve are reported too.
- Only project and timeline names are shared. Your media and files are never read.
